supersedes.reason: The original integration review found that the approved S02 plan's 10,000-row responsiveness requirement lacked a bounded component contract and governed benchmark. This record binds the independently approved pagination, real-browser interaction, performance, and Windows checkout-portability remediations while preserving the original recovery and accessibility behavior.

outcome: The reusable Academic Minimal desktop foundation now provides accessible semantic states, keyboard/focus/screen-reader behavior, safe recovery surfaces, and a bounded 10,000-row table contract with live interaction and commit-bound performance qualification, without shipping the UI-reference site or a nonfunctional table demo in the application.

integratedBehavior: The standalone ui-tokens and ui-components packages expose versioned Academic Minimal contracts with declared package dependencies, standalone type/runtime resolution, tree-shaking, strict governed styles, and complete documented evidence, uncertainty, and boundary identities.

The functional desktop provides landmarks, visible focus, skip navigation, bounded shortcuts, modal focus containment/restoration, stable theme semantics, live announcements, and actionable loading/offline/denied/stale/partial/failure/recovery states.

Large table consumers receive accessible 1-200-row pagination, first/last boundary states, polite range/page announcements, stable row identity, keyboard operation, and a measured 10,000-row fixture that never renders more than 50 rows in the approved scenario.

The performance verifier pins exact baseline bytes and p95 values, retains all samples, records hardware/OS/runtime/methodology, rejects non-finite or altered thresholds, and binds governed UTF-8 fixture content consistently across clean LF and CRLF materializations without accepting bare carriage returns.

The local-service recovery seam admits only its exact allowlisted result; malformed, credential-shaped, URL/path-bearing, extra-field, and hostile values fail closed to a nonblank generic state and fixed opaque diagnostic.

The production and development application contain exactly one functional CAP-01 page. The 32-page UI reference, the component browser harness, illustrative records, future-capability routes, and nonfunctional demos remain isolated in design or test tooling and never enter the product bundle.
reviewFixes: Added bounded accessible pagination and a representative 10,000-row performance baseline with immutable absolute and 20-percent regression limits.
Added a real-browser test-only consumer that traverses every page and verifies row bounds, contents, live ranges, keyboard focus, compact mode, and disabled boundaries.
Integrated the benchmark into the existing desktop performance verifier without modifying verification-profile or protected UI-gate controls.
Canonicalized only governed UTF-8 text fixture line endings so the release-authoritative Windows main/branch checkout remains reproducible while content drift and bare carriage returns fail closed.

residualLimitations: The actual packaged FastAPI sidecar and native process supervision are intentionally owned by CAP-01.S03; this slice exposes only the truthful not-packaged recovery seam.
Authenticated renderer-to-service transport, capability tokens, compatibility negotiation, and request cancellation are intentionally owned by CAP-01.S04.
The current functional product has no data-table workflow; downstream capabilities may consume the qualified shared DataTable only when they implement their own functional UI.
